ruling: The tier-2 candidate dataset is versioned the way D44 (ARCH-20260930-108) versions the golden scoreboard: the manifest's dataset_version and scorer_version name the current entry, and tests/test_tier2_keys.py checks that questions.json, keys.json, scorer.py and verify_keys.py hash to that entry. The set is FROZEN at frozen-2026-10-03: the owner ratified the tier-2 signoff on 2026-10-03 (the independent verification - all 268 checks - and the source review the command requires), and the manifest records the signoff. A change to any of the four files after the freeze is a new version: an entry naming the change and what triggered it.

versions.change: Initial registration of the owner-supplied candidate export (candidate/25GoldenQuestion.json, sha256 260ceecd..., 5 questions of the 25 the command expects). Separation into model-visible requests (questions.json), scorer-only keys and worked answers (keys.json), and reference sources (sources/) by extract_candidate.py. All 61 verification checks hold: every numerical key recomputed from first principles and cross-checked against keys.json's own value strings; both 29 CFR 1910.146(b) oxygen definitions matched verbatim against the archived July 1, 2014 edition and stability-cross-checked against the 2026-10-01 eCFR; every claimed wrong answer falsified under the stated assumptions; boundary operators and the discrete thickness selection verified. The provider-free scorer holds all 64 self-test fixtures (model answers, equivalent notations, tolerance boundaries, wrong answers, discrete selections). Unfrozen: the count discrepancy blocks the freeze pending the owner or advisor supplying the remaining 20 questions.
versions.verification: evals/tier2/verify_keys.py: 61/61 checks pass (exit 0). evals/tier2/scorer.py --self-test: 64/64 fixtures pass (exit 0).

versions.change: scorer.py only: the self-test now counts the fixtures it runs and prints the total in its PASS line ('all 64 fixtures hold'), so the printed output itself states its coverage - an instrument's report states what it measured (convention 26). No scoring, normalization or fixture behaviour changed; the same 64 cases run and hold. Triggered by tests/test_tier2_keys.py, which asserts on the printed fixture count.
versions.verification: evals/tier2/verify_keys.py: 61/61 checks pass (exit 0). evals/tier2/scorer.py --self-test: 64/64 fixtures pass (exit 0).

versions.change: verify_keys.py only: the Q5 worked-answer checks (Q5.5, Q5.6) read keys.json from the script's own directory even when --dir pointed elsewhere, so a copy of the dataset could pass the ordering check against the original's model answer - the one path that ignored the directory it was told to verify. verify_q5 and _model_answer now take the directory. No check semantics changed; the same 61 checks run and hold on the tree and on a faithful copy. Triggered by the suite guard's Q5.5 break-proof (swapped model-answer steps in a copied keys.json), which could not fail before the repair.
versions.verification: evals/tier2/verify_keys.py: 61/61 checks pass on the tree and on a faithful copy (exit 0 both). evals/tier2/scorer.py --self-test: 64/64 fixtures pass (exit 0).

versions.change: Registration of the complete 25-question set. Trigger: the owner supplied the remaining 20 questions on 2026-10-03 (candidate/25GoldenQuestion.json, sha256 66af3e5a..., 204068 bytes - the array the command names, registered verbatim; the executor generated, screened and selected nothing). All four lookup sources are now archived and verified: the govinfo July 1, 2014 CFR PDFs for 29 CFR 1910.95, 29 CFR 1910.146, 29 CFR 1910.147 and 40 CFR 141.62, each cross-checked against its 2026-10-01 eCFR snapshot; editions are identified by package identifier and GPO typesetting footer, not inferred from a current webpage. verify_keys.py extended to Q6-Q25: 61 -> 268 checks (deterministic recomputation of every numerical key from first principles, dimension and boundary-operator checks, discrete selections, tolerance boundaries, falsification of every claimed wrong answer, verbatim quotation matches against the archived sources). scorer.py extended with _score_q6 through _score_q25: 64 -> 248 self-test fixtures (25 model answers, 47 equivalent notations, 100 tolerance boundaries, 56 wrong answers, 20 discrete selections). The count discrepancy that blocked candidate-2026-10-03 is resolved; the remaining freeze blocker is the signoff the command requires - owner or qualified-reviewer signoff on the verification and the source review before paid use - recorded as pending in manifest.json.
versions.verification: evals/tier2/verify_keys.py: 268/268 checks pass (exit 0). evals/tier2/scorer.py --self-test: 248/248 fixtures pass (exit 0).

versions.change: The freeze the command orders after review. Trigger: the owner ratified the tier-2 signoff on 2026-10-03 ('ratify the tier-2 signoff'), covering the independent verification (all 268 checks of verify_keys.py) and the source review (four archived July 1, 2014 govinfo editions with verbatim quotation matches and 2026-10-01 eCFR stability cross-checks). The dataset content is unchanged from candidate-2026-10-03.3 - questions.json and keys.json hash identically; the two instrument files change only in what they report: the verifier's G3 check now requires the frozen state with the owner signoff recorded (manifest.json: frozen=true, freeze_blocked_by empty, a freeze record naming the signoff's grantor, time, scope and effect), and both instruments' closing lines report the frozen version instead of the pending signoff. extract_candidate.py (the manifest's generator) carries the freeze record so re-running it reproduces manifest.json byte-for-byte. Paid use of the set is permitted subject to the tier-3 command's own ratification requirements (ARCH-20261002-118).
versions.verification: evals/tier2/verify_keys.py: 268/268 checks pass (exit 0). evals/tier2/scorer.py --self-test: 248/248 fixtures pass (exit 0). evals/tier2/extract_candidate.py re-run reproduces manifest.json byte-for-byte (the extraction-idempotency guard).
